name: Seeed XIAO ESP32C6
radio: the SoC's own radios: wifi24, ble, ieee802154

flash.bootloader_instructions: Hold BOOT while plugging in USB-C; release after a second. The chip's USB-JTAG-serial port appears.
flash.note: Not a board kitsune builds for; fox-bench carries a PlatformIO env for it (firmware/kitsune/extra/). Offset 0x0 is the ESP32-C6 convention. Serial over native USB confirmed on the bench (the factory sketch prints 'Hello from Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C6').

usb.when: ESP32-C6 USB-JTAG-serial (download mode and, with CDC on boot, the running firmware)

led.note: yellow LED on GPIO15; fox-bench's env passes -D DATA_PIN=15, which kitsune's FastLED path drives as a digital LED (it will not show colours; on/off at best)

battery.divider_note: Powered from USB or a 5 V pack. kitsune's note: the pack must not have a low-current cut-off, or the board never wakes from deep sleep.

notes: Adds a second 802.15.4 radio to the bench: a partner for the C5 Zigbee coordinator.
Candidate for a PR to kitsune ('other platformio supported hardware'): one env stanza and an LED entry.

serial.notes: kitsune prints 'ESP32 boot count', 'Awake and screaming', 'Going to sleep' and 'PANIC' on its serial port; no command interface.
